label: <DEL> step in short sequences (L<=6), plus first early v
explanation: Mostly a delimiter-step unit: about 72% of activation mass is on the <DEL> input, and it depends strongly on sequence length (the delimiter fires 98% of the time when L<=4, about 89% when L<=5, and rarely when L>=7). The largest activations are <DEL> in L=3 sequences. A secondary component (about 18% of mass) is the first occurrence of v during the original phase at steps 1-5. Weaker first-occurrence responses to d, 1, u and k at early steps are not captured. It essentially never fires in the copy phase, at t=0, or on repeated tokens. Magnitude decreases with L (equivalently, with the step index t of the delimiter).
